products.title: Limited Edition: Paris 01
products.body_html:
Engineered around AHLEM’s proprietary double-rim construction, Paris 01 is built from two precisely milled stainless-steel circles, interlocked through a V-shaped geometry developed entirely in-house. The result is absolute continuity of form — without gap, interruption, or visible separation.

Double-beveled metal rims refine the structure through controlled planes of reflection: one polished to intensify light, one hand-brushed to absorb it. The contrast sharpens the architecture of the frame while reducing visual weight.

An original V-groove lens channel allows the lens to sit seamlessly within the rim. A concealed rim-lock system secures the structure without disturbing the purity of the line.

Handcrafted in France.
Electro-dipped in 22k gold.
Limited to 600 pieces per color.
